name: Crow
publication: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage
section: Level 23, Mad Wizard’s Lair, 36. Gate to Triboar
sourceAccess: Rules verified in the first-print adventure facsimile. The D&D Beyond adventure index identifies the book and encounter level.
errataEvidence: The official Sage Advice & Errata index has no dedicated Dungeon of the Mad Mage correction sheet. No official correction to this encounter was located. The official 2014 Monster Manual errata has no change to this exact base entry.
operationalEvidence: The adventure directs the reader to the Raven statistics and adds the ordinary crow’s encounter behavior. Raven’s Perception bonus, Mimicry and Beak are retained.
appearanceEvidence: The adventure specifies an ordinary crow. The approved roster reuses the natural black corvid portrait from Raven, the encounter’s rules base.
habitatEvidence: Habitat tags based on the printed encounter location.
